page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing 64 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via KVM.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, while single-core metrics remain in the average range. The instance achieves a strong multi-core stress-ng CPU performance score of 62175.76 and a strong PassMark CPU score of 55256.18. Multi-threaded operations, such as bzip3 decompression at 286.21 GB/sec and software compilation with Clang at 41379.0, also rank in the top 25 percent. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with read-only large block speeds at 170.68 GB/sec and write speeds at 69.67 GB/sec.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that benefit from high parallel processing capacity. Strong performance in database operations and static web serving throughput makes it appropriate for enterprise web serving and database hosting. Additionally, its strong performance in small-scale LLM inference supports lightweight machine learning tasks, though the lack of local storage and GPUs limits its utility for large-scale deep learning or high-I/O storage-heavy applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 64 dedicated physical cores (64 vCPUs) and 256.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 resource ratio. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor, provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and contains no local storage or GPUs. Performance benchmarks show strong multi-core capabilities, with high scores in multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, and database operations, while single-core performance remains average. This hardware profile is highly suited for parallelized workloads, including enterprise web serving, database hosting, and small-scale language model inference.
